Bitkey review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026 · Independent: sponsors can't buy a verdict · How we rate

Verdict: A bitcoin-only 2-of-3 multisig wallet with built-in inheritance: your beneficiary starts a claim, and funds unlock only after a 6-month delay you can cancel. Best for: Bitcoin holders who want simple self-custody with inheritance built in.

Good

Best for

Bitcoin holders who want simple self-custody with inheritance built in.

Skip if

you hold coins other than bitcoin, or your heir won't use a Bitkey device

Pros

  • Built-in inheritance with a 6-month security delay
  • You get alerts and can cancel a claim
  • No seed phrase; 2-of-3 multisig

Cons

  • Bitcoin only
  • Beneficiary needs their own Bitkey device
  • Bitkey says a beneficiary isn't automatically the legal owner; your will may take precedence
